# Ibrahim Kasoma

> Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, React, Node.js) based in Stroud, England, UK. 6+ years building production TypeScript across frontend and backend-integrated systems: 80+ apps shipped, reaching 3.4M+ monthly users in 60+ markets on EF Education First's flagship Next.js platform. Open to senior frontend / platform roles in the UK.

Key facts:

- Current role: Senior Frontend Engineer at EF Education First (London, UK · hybrid), March 2023–present.
- Signature results at EF: page loads cut by 60% on a 3.4M-MAU Next.js platform; CI/CD pipeline reduced from 45 to 15 minutes shipping 17 production apps daily; Nx monorepo consolidating 20+ microfrontends across 8 product teams (−15,000 lines of duplicate code); test coverage lifted from ~30% to 85%.
- Core stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, Nx, AWS, GCP, GitHub Actions, Storybook, Jest, Cypress.
- Contact: kasomaibrahim@gmail.com (replies within a day).
